bench_meta: 216 pages × 4 turns, and 119 held-out owner pages for the local routes · Gemini through the gateway, the rest free on the Mac (W46.rotation-routes)
bench_note: Each upright page turned 0, 90, 180 and 270 degrees; a route is right when it gives the turn that makes it upright. Wrong axis = sideways, flip = upside down, abstain = no answer. The gateway's Gemini 3.7 Flash runs the app's comparative which-of-four prompt (llmSingle one call, llmMajority three, on a 108-page half); the local models ran on a 48-page subset. Vision is right on 99.0% of the owner's turns and never wrong there, but wrong-axis on charters; llmSingle is 100% on the 96 and 97.3% on the public strata; Vision and PP-LCNet agreeing, else llmSingle, is 100% on the 96 with 7 of 384 turns sent to the model, but the 96 are the shipped detector's development set: on 119 held-out owner pages Vision is right at all four turns on 107 and wrong on 6, and Vision with PP-LCNet flagging is wrong on 5 and flags 14. The small local models are at chance with a one-image prompt; Qwen3-VL 8B with the app's comparative prompt is 78.1%, below Vision on the owner's pages. Seconds were taken inside an unattended session (background QoS), so compare them, don't quote them. Detail: ArchiveProcessor/segbench-results/rotation-routes.md.
